outbox.body:
Hi Margaret,

Thank you for contacting claims support. Here is a summary of today's conversation.

WHAT WE DISCUSSED
  - You asked about the denial of your January healthcare claim, which was denied because the pathology report and treating provider’s office note were missing.
  - You asked how to submit the missing documents; you can use the member portal or claim upload link, or contact support about fax or mail submission.
  - You asked about document requirements, including submitting complete, readable files with relevant dates and provider or facility information visible when available.
  - You asked how long review takes after submission; processing is usually less than a week, though intake and another review cycle may be needed.
  - You were informed that the appeal deadline has passed, and a human claims representative can discuss whether a late appeal may be possible.

CLAIM STATUS
  CL-2048 (healthcare, filed 2026-01-12): DENIED
  Healthcare claim denied due to missing pathology report and office note.
  Reason: the review file did not include the pathology report and the treating provider office note.

NEXT STEPS
  - Submit the pathology report via the member portal or claim upload link.
  - Submit the office note via the member portal or claim upload link.
  - After submission, review usually takes usually less than a week.
  - The appeal deadline on file (2026-03-18) has passed; contact us if you'd like a claims representative to look into it.
  - Reply to this email or call us if you have more questions.

Best regards,
Claims Support

outbox.body:
Hi Margaret,

Thank you for contacting claims support. Here is a summary of today's conversation.

WHAT WE DISCUSSED
  - You asked about your denied healthcare claim from January, identified as claim CL-2048.
  - You confirmed the claim was denied because the pathology report and treating provider’s office note were missing from the review file.
  - You asked where to upload the missing files and were advised to use the member portal or claim upload link, keeping the documents attached to the claim.
  - You were informed that the appeal deadline had passed and that a human claims representative could provide information about late appeals or alternative submission methods.
  - You requested that a summary of the conversation be emailed to the address on file.

CLAIM STATUS
  CL-2048 (healthcare, filed 2026-01-12): DENIED
  Healthcare claim denied due to missing pathology report and office note.
  Reason: the review file did not include the pathology report and the treating provider office note.

NEXT STEPS
  - Submit the pathology report via the member portal or claim upload link.
  - Submit the office note via the member portal or claim upload link.
  - After submission, review usually takes usually less than a week.
  - The appeal deadline on file (2026-03-18) has passed; contact us if you'd like a claims representative to look into it.
  - Reply to this email or call us if you have more questions.

Best regards,
Claims Support
